reason: Verified the jira-clone journey in the browser on both lanes and measured every fact the cell needs (seven style probes identical across lanes, exact seam inventory, drag/modal/create/filter selectors, scroll absence, seed-board restore). Three spec contradictions surfaced: create-issue is navbar item :nth-of-type(3) (item 2 is a search drawer whose overlay hangs the journey), one Backspace does not widen the filter, and the reload cancels a third Sentry envelope POST whose failure the generic inventory would record by full URL including the DSN public key. Wrote no repository files; the remaining work also exceeds one unit.
